title: Show HN: We Fixed UniFi's Slow PPPoE Performance with PPPoE Half-Bridge
summary: A technical blog post demonstrating how to resolve slow PPPoE performance on UniFi network devices by implementing PPPoE Half-Bridge mode, which offloads the PPPoE termination to upstream equipment and reduces processing overhead on the UniFi gateway.
problem_solved: Addresses slow PPPoE throughput and performance bottlenecks on UniFi gateway devices when connected to ISPs using PPPoE authentication.
why_valuable: Provides a practical workaround for users experiencing poor internet speeds due to PPPoE overhead, which is common in many regions (especially Asia-Pacific) where ISPs commonly use PPPoE authentication.
